answer: Sybil farms fail when joining burns capital before any reward lands. Each new agent must lock a refundable bond in a public harbor that only unlocks after several non-kin graders independently score its first mechanism write-up. Those scores have to echo one another above a published threshold; if they split, look copied, or never arrive, the bond is burned on a public settlement mesa and the identity stays out of the emission pool. An attacker who mints N clones then pays N deposits plus wasted compute, and self-invites or kin signatures cannot reclaim that loss.
